---
const { default: logoAnimatedInnerHtml } = await import(
  `@public/logo_animated.svg?raw`
);
---

<section
  id="loading"
  class="pointer-events-none fixed flex items-center justify-center inset-0 w-screen h-screen backdrop-blur-md bg-h-400 bg-opacity-40 transition-opacity ease-in-out duration-500 z-[9999]"
  style="opacity: 0"
>
  <div
    class="block w-24 h-auto object-center object-contain bg-transparent"
    set:html={logoAnimatedInnerHtml}
    style="opacity:inherit;"
    transition:name="loader"
    transition:persist
  />
</section>
